item.title: Claude Opus 5
item.description: Claude Opus 5 is Anthropic’s top-tier model, tuned specifically for agentic coding — multi-file features, large refactors, and end-to-end implementation work rather than single-shot completions. Give it a full task specification up front and it tends to run the whole way to a finished result instead of leaving stubs behind.

item.title: GPT-5.6 Sol
item.description: GPT-5.6 Sol is the top tier of OpenAI’s three-model GPT-5.6 lineup (Luna, Terra, Sol), positioned as the strongest option for coding, enterprise work, and cybersecurity tasks, with a claim on efficiency alongside raw capability.
